title: Running Total with CTE and Window Function
description: Calculate a running total of monthly sales using a CTE and SUM OVER.

data.text: Write a query to show each month's sales and a running total of sales year-to-date.

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
WITH MonthlySales AS (
    SELECT
        YEAR(OrderDate) AS OrderYear,
        MONTH(OrderDate) AS OrderMonth,
        SUM(TotalAmount) AS MonthlyTotal
    FROM Orders
    GROUP BY YEAR(OrderDate), MONTH(OrderDate)
)
SELECT
    OrderYear,
    OrderMonth,
    MonthlyTotal,
    SUM(MonthlyTotal) OVER (
        PARTITION BY OrderYear
        ORDER BY OrderMonth
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS RunningTotal
FROM MonthlySales
ORDER BY OrderYear, OrderMonth;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: The ROWS BETWEEN clause defines the window frame. UNBOUNDED PRECEDING starts from the first row in the partition, CURRENT ROW is the current row. This accumulates all prior months. RANGE BETWEEN can also be used with numeric or date ordering.
